items.title: Sands interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: Her and Wynton Marsalis actually taught me how to really study music.

ctx.x: What did you learn from her?

Oof. What didn’t I learn? She was just a beautiful person man, a beautiful spirit and an amazing, amazing pianist and composer and everything. Amazing mother. I got to spend a lot of time with her and her kids. And you know I just learned how to be a warm person you know, and how to present music, and actually how to study music. Her and Wynton Marsalis actually taught me how to really study music. And you know, prepare for things and prepare for concerts and prepare for, you know, just a musical life ahead of…
Nice. And you took over from her with the Errol Garner project?
